events.title: Tupac Shakur's Tragic Anniversary
events.blurb: On September 7, 1996, American rapper Tupac Shakur was shot in a drive-by shooting in Las Vegas, dying six days later on September 13.

angles.name: Remembering a hip-hop icon
angles.copy: Remembering a hip-hop icon whose music continues to resonate. What's your go-to Tupac track?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix Anniversary
events.blurb: Jimi Hendrix died in London on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27, due to barbiturate-related asphyxia.

angles.name: Still influencing guitarists today
angles.copy: Still influencing guitarists today, Jimi Hendrix left us far too soon. His legacy is undeniable.

events.title: Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' in the UK on September 26, 1969, featuring tracks like 'Something' and 'Here Comes The Sun'.

angles.name: Iconic album cover
angles.copy: That album cover... still instantly recognisable. The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' turns another year older. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Still rocking after all these years
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking after all these years with that unmistakable voice.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Still the voice of a generation
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to Liam Gallagher! Still the voice of a generation, with that iconic swagger. What's your favourite Oasis or Liam solo tune?

events.title: Imagine Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal album 'Imagine' was released in the US on September 9, 1971, and in the UK on October 8, 1971.

angles.name: A timeless message of peace
angles.copy: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album celebrates another year. A timeless message of peace and hope that still resonates today.

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple released the very first iPod in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: Remember your first iPod?
angles.copy: Remember your first iPod? It's the anniversary of Apple's iconic device that changed how we listen to music forever!

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day celebrates the premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in London on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, not stirred... it's James Bond Day!
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred... it's James Bond Day! Which Bond actor is your favourite, and what's the best 007 theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

angles.name: His music still resonates today
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message still resonate today.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Still making us laugh
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the comedy legend John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, he's still making us laugh.

events.title: White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: A sprawling masterpiece
angles.copy: The Beatles' 'White Album' celebrates another anniversary. A sprawling, diverse masterpiece that showed the Fab Four at their most experimental.

events.title: Freddie Mercury Anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering the iconic Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Still the ultimate showman
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury. Still the ultimate showman with a voice that transcended generations.

events.title: Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' in the UK on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: A pivotal moment in music history
angles.copy: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' album turns another year older. A pivotal moment in music history that saw the band push new boundaries.
